# FutureTense fixtures

Positive cases. Each line must produce exactly one Atmos.FutureTense finding,
and the reported match must span through to the verb, not stop at an adverb.

Atmos will publish a major release when a breaking change lands.

Atmos will not overwrite the file.

Atmos will automatically install the toolchain.

Atmos will always resolve the alias first.

Atmos will not only validate the stack but also render it.

The command will then write the varfile.

Negative cases. None of these may produce a finding.

Atmos writes the file to disk.

The `will` field has no effect.

This runs at will, whenever the operator decides.

Goodwill and free will are not future tense.

Will Smith is a proper noun.
